publishErrors.NO_CHANGES: No changes have been made since the last published version.
publishErrors.NO_LESSONS: A course with no lessons cannot be published.
publishErrors.NO_SCENES: A course where no lesson has any scenes cannot be published.
publishErrors.EMPTY_LESSON: Lesson “{{lesson}}” has no scenes. Add at least one scene before publishing.
publishErrors.EMPTY_SCENE: Scene “{{scene}}” has no content. Add content to every scene before publishing.
publishErrors.UNREADABLE_SCENE: Scene “{{scene}}” cannot be read. Open the scene, save it again, then publish.
publishErrors.UNVALIDATED_PRACTICE: Cannot publish: {{count}} practice scene(s) are not finished — {{scenes}}.
publishErrors.UNANSWERABLE_QUESTIONS: {{count}} question(s) have no complete answer key — {{questions}}.
publishErrors.ZERO_VALUE_QUESTIONS: {{count}} question(s) are worth nothing — {{questions}}. Give them a value above zero, or remove the field to use the default.
publishErrors.DUPLICATE_BLOCK_ID: {{count}} question(s) share a blockId with another question in the same scene — {{questions}}.
publishErrors.OUTDATED_SCENES: {{count}} scene(s) cite sources that changed. Review those scenes, or publish anyway to proceed as-is.

publishDialog.title: Publish Course
publishDialog.description: This will create a new published version of the course. Members currently enrolled will remain on their existing version.
publishDialog.supersedeDescription: If checked, users enrolled in previous versions will be automatically moved to this new version. Their progress might be lost if scenes were removed or changed significantly.
publishDialog.gateDialogDescription: Publishing a course is part of a subscription. Everything you have built stays open to edit and to preview.
publishDialog.gateDescription: Subscribe to publish this course and enroll learners. Authoring and preview are unaffected. Nothing you have built is locked away.
publishDialog.gateLapsedDescription: Courses can no longer be published. Reactivate the subscription to publish and enroll again; authoring and preview stay open.
